title: Lifting a machine to a larger alphabet
statement: Let $M$ be a deterministic machine with Boolean symbols, $k$ work tapes, and state set $S$, and let $e$ inject the Boolean alphabet into $\Gamma$. The machine over $\Gamma$ has the same initial state. On a transition, it decodes the input and each scanned work-tape symbol when that symbol lies in the image of $e$ (treating all other symbols as blank), applies the transition of $M$, and maps its written and output symbols through $e$.
hypotheses_covered: A machine with Boolean symbols, $k$ work tapes, and state set $S$
